summary: Indian investors are looking beyond domestic markets, with overseas equities and crypto both seeing strong participation. The data reveals that investors are using both as part of a broader diversification strategy.

title: 8th Pay Commission: Govt gives status report in Lok Sabha; what employees should know
summary: The government said the 8th Pay Commission was given 18 months from the date of its constitution to submit its report. Here's who could benefit and what remains undecided on salaries and pensions.

title: Not all multi-asset allocation funds are alike: Only one scheme is rated low risk —why others are red-flagged
summary: Multi-asset allocation funds may look similar, but their risk profiles can be poles apart. Of the 34 schemes, only one carries a Low risk rating, while five are rated High risk. The portfolio mix offers some clues.

title: Repo rate stays at 5.25%: Why your home loan EMI may still change in 2026 and what historical data shows
summary: Even if the RBI keeps the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% in 2026, your home loan EMI may not stay the same. MCLR-linked loans can move independently, while even repo-linked loans may see changes. Historical data reveals an uneven link between the MCLR and policy rate.&nbsp;

title: REIT, InvIT dividend tax relief may boost investor returns; know who benefits and what remains taxable
summary: The proposed tax change could make REIT and InvIT dividends tax-free for investors regardless of the tax regime chosen by the underlying SPV. However, interest and other components of distributions will remain taxable, so investors must check the payout breakup before calculating post-tax returns.

title: Ladli Behna Yojana MP: 39th instalment of ₹1,500 may arrive early as Raksha Bandhan gift
summary: The Ladli Behna Yojana serves as a crucial pillar for economic empowerment, supplying eligible women across Madhya Pradesh with direct financial assistance of ₹1,500 every month.

title: Received an income tax notice? Here's why you should authenticate it and how to do it online
summary: Filed ITR for AY 2026-27 and received an income tax notice? Before responding, taxpayers can authenticate it online to check whether it was genuinely issued by the department. Here’s how the DIN and OTP-based verification can help you spot fake notices.

title: Will you be charged for UPI peer transfers, grocery payments? MyGovIndia busts myths on MDR; here's what stays free
summary: Viral claims suggest UPI payments could soon become chargeable after a recent PSS Act amendment. MyGovIndia has clarified that routine personal UPI transfers remain free. Here are the key myths and facts every UPI user should be aware of.

title: Capital Gains Tax: How stocks, ETFs and equity mutual funds are taxed now
summary: For equity mutual funds, exchange-traded funds and stocks, the holding period required to qualify as a long-term investment is more than 12 months. STCG on these assets is taxed at 20%, while LTCG is taxed at 12.5% on gains exceeding the applicable annual exemption threshold.

title: Closing a credit card with outstanding EMI? Experts explain hidden charges and rules
summary: Cancelling a credit card with an outstanding EMI does not erase repayment obligations. Know what happens to EMIs, foreclosure charges, pending dues and credit scores before closing your card.&nbsp;

title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
summary: Indian stock markets opened muted this week as global worries tempered investor sentiment. Strong first-quarter earnings provided some support, offsetting geopolitical tensions. Analysts noted softer US jobs data, shifting focus to inflation readings for rate direction.

title: Milky Mist Dairy Food mops up ₹465 crore from anchor investors ahead of IPO
summary: Milky Mist Dairy Food raised ₹465.29 crore from anchor investors ahead of its IPO opening on August 11. The ₹1,553 crore issue offers shares priced at ₹133-140, with a minimum investment of ₹14,980. The IPO closes August 13, targeting a listing on August 18.

title: NSE indices rejig: Vodafone Idea, Wipro part of major changes in Nifty Next 50 and Nifty 100. Check full list
summary: NSE Indices announced major semi-annual rejig changes across Nifty 500, Nifty 100 and Nifty Next 50, effective September 30. BSE, Polycab, Hitachi Energy India, Vodafone Idea and Wipro will enter key indices, while several companies face exclusion.

title: Nifty rejig: IT major Wipro to move out of benchmark index after BSE gets inclusion
summary: Wipro will exit India's benchmark Nifty index, while BSE Ltd will enter. These changes will take effect from September 30, 2026, after market close. BSE's inclusion follows its six-month average free-float market cap crossing the required threshold.

title: Intel shares drop 5% after announcing $15 billion offering to support AI growth
summary: Intel shares fell over 5% after the semiconductor giant announced a $15 billion common stock offering to fund capital needs and support AI-driven growth opportunities. The offering aims to strengthen its balance sheet while expanding capacity for rising AI compute demand.

title: High margin debt! JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon fires a warning shot for Wall Street investors
summary: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon warned that record margin debt and hidden leverage across financial markets could increase the risk of a sudden disruption. While stopping short of calling it systemic, he cautioned that forced selling after market declines could amplify volatility.

title: US stocks: Retail investors sold SpaceX shares for first time on Friday
summary: For the first time since its launch, retail investors sold off SpaceX shares, coinciding with a rebound towards its IPO price. title: Fusion Finance turns profitable as asset quality improves sharply
summary: Fusion Finance reported a Rs 62.4 crore Q1 profit, reversing a year-ago loss, as improving asset quality lifted performance. Gross NPA declined to 2.5%, while net interest margin improved. A strong capital adequacy ratio and higher AUM further strengthened the lender’s balance sheet.

title: Vodafone Idea Q1 Results: Loss narrows to Rs 3,754 crore; revenue rises 6% YoY
summary: Vodafone Idea Q1 Results: Debt-ridden telco Vodafone Idea on Monday narrowed its consolidated losses in the first quarter to Rs 3,754 crore. The loss stood at Rs 6,608 crore in the last year quarter. Revenue from operations increased 6% YoY to Rs 11,689 crore.
